#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    // Fast input
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;

    // Use 1-indexed arrays for consistency with Java code
    vector<int> arr(n + 1);
    vector<int> oddcount(n + 1, 0);
    vector<int> evencount(n + 1, 0);

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 1) {
            oddcount[i] = oddcount[i - 1] + 1;
            evencount[i] = evencount[i - 1];
        } else {
            oddcount[i] = oddcount[i - 1];
            evencount[i] = evencount[i - 1] + 1;
        }
    }

    int size = n / 2 - 1;
    vector<int> arr2(max(0, size), 0);

    if (size > 0) {
        for (int i = 2; i < n; i += 2) {
            int idx = i / 2 - 1;
            if (oddcount[i] == evencount[i]) {
                arr2[idx] = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]);
            } else {
                arr2[idx] = -1;
            }
        }

        sort(arr2.begin(), arr2.end());

        int cut = 0;
        long long sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            if (arr2[i] != -1 && sum + arr2[i] <= b) {
                cut++;
                sum += arr2[i];
            }
        }
        cout << cut << endl;
    } else {
        // When size <= 0, no cuts possible
        cout << 0 << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
